name: CompactBarTrend

props.description: Row data — one bar per row. Any point count (7 is not hard-coded).
props.name: data

props.description: Key into each datum holding the category (tick) label.
props.name: categoryKey

props.description: Key into each datum holding the plotted numeric value.
props.name: valueKey

props.description: Paint `label` as a visible caption. Set false when a CardTitle or section heading already says it — the caption stays in the DOM as sr-only, so role=img keeps its accessible name.
props.name: showCaption

props.description: Extra context appended to the screen-reader description.
props.name: description

props.description: Plot-height tier (--chart-trend-plot-height-*). xs is the dashboard summary-card density.
props.name: size

props.description: Index of the emphasized 'current' bar. Negative counts from the end (-1 = latest); out of range = no emphasis. Also annotated in the text alternative, so it is never colour-only.
props.name: emphasizedIndex

props.description: Render the category tick labels under the plot.
props.name: showCategoryLabels

props.description: Locale-aware formatting for the values in the text alternative.
props.name: numberFormat

props.description: Activity footer slot below the plot, rendered OUTSIDE the role=img graphic so links/buttons in it stay reachable.
props.name: footer

related: BarChart — full cartesian bar chart with axes/grid/tooltip/legend (requires the recharts optional peer).
StatCard — the KPI headline this trend usually sits under.
Progress — one ratio against a target, not a series over time.
tagline: DEPENDENCY-FREE compact vertical bar trend for dashboard summary cards — N category/value pairs, muted marks plus ONE emphasized 'current' bar, all geometry from --chart-trend-* tokens. Needs NO recharts. Sparkline / micro-chart / activity pulse / KPI trend strip.
usage: DO import from the isolated entry: `import { CompactBarTrend } from "@godxjp/ui/charts/compact-bar-trend";` — unlike the charts barrel, this path never links modules that require the optional `recharts` peer.
DO reach for it INSIDE a dashboard summary card (a 7-day signup/organization/activity strip under a StatCard headline) — that is the density `size="xs"` is tuned for.
DO mark the current period with `emphasizedIndex={-1}` (or an explicit index); the highlight is duplicated in the screen-reader text alternative, so it never depends on colour alone.

DO retheme through the `--chart-trend-*` tokens (bar gap/radius/width, plot heights, muted + emphasis fills, opt-in baseline). NEVER add page-local CSS, an inline height calculation, or a hardcoded colour.
DON'T use it when you need axes, a grid, tooltips, multiple series, or a continuous trend — that is BarChart / LineChart / AreaChart (recharts peer). DON'T fake bars with styled divs in the app.
DON'T put interactive content in the plot: anything clickable goes in `footer`, which renders outside the `role="img"` graphic.
useCases: Seven-day new-organizations / new-users trend inside an admin dashboard summary card (SCR-201).
Weekly activity pulse beside a KPI headline, where the SHAPE matters more than exact figures.
A dependency-constrained app (no recharts) that still needs a token-driven chart.
